name: W Hong Kong
insider_take: Where East meets electrifying — W Hong Kong sits 76 floors above Kowloon, redefining luxury with a pulse that never stops.
whats_special: Perched in the iconic Elements mall complex at Union Square, W Hong Kong is one of the tallest hotels in the world. The property is a playground for design lovers, boasting jaw-dropping harbor and skyline views, an award-winning WET® deck pool, and the legendary WOOBAR — a social hub that buzzes day and night. As part of Marriott's Luminous Program, elite travelers enjoy elevated perks and recognition throughout their stay.
pro_tip: Book a room on the highest floors facing Victoria Harbour — the panoramic views of Hong Kong Island's glittering skyline are absolutely worth the upgrade. Ask about Luminous Program benefits when booking to maximize your rewards.
dont_miss: The rooftop WET® deck is a must — sip cocktails poolside while taking in one of the most dramatic urban backdrops on the planet. Just steps away, the MTR connects you directly to Hong Kong Island, making exploring the city effortlessly seamless.
pros: Stunning Victoria Harbour views from premium rooms
Ultra-modern design with vibrant contemporary interiors
Prime location in Tsim Sha Tsui with easy access to shopping and attractions
Exceptional rooftop bar and dining venues with panoramic city views
cons: Bold contemporary design may not suit traditional preferences
